rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion to a New Hampshire v. Maine–anchored, holistic standard rejecting the Fifth Circuit’s near-per-se “knowledge + motive” inference while preserving estoppel for record-supported manipulation. Alito is likely to dissent to emphasize deterrence and bankruptcy-integrity concerns, and one or more concurrences (especially Gorsuch/Thomas/Barrett/Sotomayor) may stress limits on federal common-law forfeiture and creditor-protective bankruptcy remedies.
